mapper.insert: insert into cart( cart_no, cart_quantity, cart_price, m_no, p_no ) values( cart_seq.nextval, #{cart_quantity}, #{cart_price}, #{m_no}, #{p_no} )
mapper.select: select c.cart_no, c.cart_quantity, c.cart_price, c.m_no, c.p_no, p.p_name, p.p_price, p.p_image from cart c join product p on c.p_no = p.p_no where m_no = #{m_no} order by cart_no asc
